Police Deployed in Raipur's Nakti Village Ahead of Eviction

Over 1000 police personnel have been deployed in Nakti village, Raipur, with preparations underway to vacate two wards. The deployment suggests an imminent eviction or demolition drive, as indicated by the readiness for "bulldozer action."
